purpose: Optimize and validate the numerical forecaster before any new Wiki optimization. Do not claim Wiki contribution from these changes.
diagnosis: Original numerical fitting uses only first60% of each outer-train period and reserves last30% for Wiki. In fold1 the original zero-head/persistence checkpoint wins internal MAE selection. The base has not established extra predictive skill. These are code/log facts, not proof that more recent labels alone will fix accuracy.
data: Same raw hourly CSV, no label edits/imputation/sample removal, input72/horizon2/stride3 and exact original outer cohort. Keep original prefix-fitted input scaler for all models. Numerical training may now use all six turbines; no knowledge memory is built.
inner_selection: Last10% of original outer-train timeline. Fit/selection cuts group clocks, not turbine rows; purge target crossings. Use only joint non-worse original-scale MAE/RMSE relative to Persistence and minimize their mean ratio. Freeze candidate and epoch before any outer prediction or metric is computed; file loading/window availability checks are not outcome-based model selection.
ridge_features: 77 numerical-only causal current/lag-difference/short-mean coordinates from the same seven channels; lag1,2,3,6,12,24; means3,6,12,24. Fit feature scaler and residual targets on fitting period only.
PromptExpanded: Same original PromptTimeDART architecture, old pretrain initializer reused without pretraining again, original backbone/new LR and MIXED .2 loss. Calibrate regime thresholds on current fitting labels/history after state transfer. Use the expanded recent numerical labels, not old Wiki cases.
ResidualTCN: Zero-head direct residual forecast around actual last power. Center power history only, retain absolute standardized wind/control values. Three causal dilations and last/3h/12h pooling. No pretrained backbone, no Wiki, no learned confidence gate. Loss=.5 MAE/fit-persistence-MAE + .5 MSE/fit-persistence-MSE; constants fitted only on fitting labels.
fallback: Exact Persistence if no candidate has joint internal improvement. Do not select nominal float-rounding improvements or epoch0 checkpoints.
outer_refit: Only the internally selected candidate is refit once on full original outer-train labels. Freeze selected hyperparameters and neural epoch count; retain original20epoch cosine schedule; never select outer best epoch. DeltaRidge refits feature scaler/coefficients on full training. If fallback, do not train. No second candidate outer refit after inspecting outer performance.
comparisons: Exact same outer windows vs Persistence and frozen original PromptTimeDART, plus source DLinear/PatchTST/Ridge outputs as historical references. Their old60% fitting budget is explicitly different; do not call those capacity/budget-matched modern tuned baselines.
primary_success: Selected-refit numerical model must jointly improve MAE/RMSE vs Persistence and original TimeDART. R2/skills/capacity hits also reported. One development fold is not sufficient to claim stable cross-fold success or resume Wiki optimization automatically.
budget: Two inner neural runs20epochs each and three fixed Ridge penalties, then one selected full-train refit only. No new Wiki, seed, outer-guided candidate or additional penalty/loss search.
resource_policy: Use existing adaptive shared GPU limits when others run; no signals/reconfiguration of other processes; no duplicate suites
forbidden: Wiki training before numerical skill is established
reusing old Wiki certificates with a changed numerical base
limitations: Historically inspected development outer fold. Current internal time period has also been seen in prior development, though this bounded search never consumes outer labels. This is a newly declared numerical optimization protocol, not independent confirmation or a single-factor causal attribution. No guaranteed R2 target.
